---
title: Learning Page Template
description: A reusable structure for tutorial-style or course-style documentation.
sidebar:
  order: 2
---

Use this template when Setu is configured as a learning site:

```markdown
---
title: Topic Title
description: State what the reader will understand or complete.
sidebar:
  order: 1
---

Explain why the topic matters.

## Learning objectives

- Understand the central idea.
- Apply it in a practical example.
- Verify the result.

## Explanation

Introduce the concept in focused sections.

## Practice

Provide a small task or interactive example.

## Summary

Restate the important decisions and link to the next topic.
```
